# Shapes, fill and erase
## Shape (5)
Pick a tile or an entity in the palette, then press 5. Decals can't be drawn as shapes.
Pick the shape in Properties under [bold]Shape[/bold]: Line, Rectangle or Circle. Under [bold]Draw[/bold], [bold]Fill[/bold] makes it solid and [bold]Border[/bold] draws only its edge.
[bold]Drag[/bold] Draw it. A preview shows until you let go. [bold]Shift[/bold] while dragging Square rectangle, round circle [bold]Right click[/bold] Switch Fill and Border, or drop a drag [bold]Ctrl+wheel[/bold] Turn the entities you draw
A circle is the ellipse that fits the dragged box. One shape covers at most 4096 tiles.
## Which grid it lands on
The shape goes on the grid under the start of the drag, else the grid under its end, else a grid it touches. The preview snaps to that grid's tiles.
- Floor drawn past a grid's edge makes the grid bigger. - Floor drawn in space joins the nearest grid, or starts a new one after [bold]New grid[/bold] or on an empty level. - Entities need a grid. Cells with no floor are skipped and the popup says how many. Lay the floor first.
## Fill (4)
Hold a tile and click a tile on a grid. Every tile of the clicked type connected to it becomes your tile. Click empty space inside a grid to fill the connected empty cells, up to the grid's outer edge. The fill stops at 4096 tiles and says so.
## Erase (2)
Set the target in Properties under [bold]Erase[/bold]:
[bold]Everything[/bold] Entities, then decals, then the floor. The default. [bold]Entities[/bold] Only entities. [bold]Tiles[/bold] Only the floor. [bold]Decals[/bold] Only decals.
- [bold]Click[/bold]: removes one thing. Big sprites, such as a 2x2 machine, can be clicked anywhere on them. - [bold]Drag[/bold]: removes everything of that kind in the box, up to 4096 tiles. A drag can start in space to clear loose things floating off a grid. - [bold]Right click[/bold]: opens [bold]Delete under cursor[/bold], a list of everything under the cursor by name and prototype. Pick one to remove it. Where sprites overlap and the click hits none exactly, the list opens by itself.
Everything removes its entities, decals and floor as separate steps, so undo brings them back one at a time.
Players, ghosts and other mappers are never erased.
